info.title: Mane Man API: the ops console
info.description: mm-api on the ops console's host (docs/decisions/0026-hosts-and-surfaces.md), served at https://{host}/api/*, behind Cloudflare Access. Every call needs a valid Access token and is recorded in the audit log under its identity (docs/decisions/0031-access-and-audit.md). Every response carries an X-Request-Id header.

fields.description: invalid_request: the fields that failed validation, never their values; superseded: what changed under the caller.

version_tag.description: Tag given at upload: the git commit SHA in remote environments.
